entry.title: New: RES26-245 (Honolulu) — INTRO
entry.content:
RELATING TO THE TRANSFER OF FUNDS.

Request to transfer FY2027 funds to cover projected salary deficits due to the Cumulative result of several factors affecting personnel costs, including contractual salary obligations, overtime required to maintain minimum staffing levels during persistent vacancies, increased recruit hiring, and other personnel-related operational requirements and initiatives that are unbudgeted.

Latest action: Introduced.
